Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000846": On 2025-11-04, the Ember team observed that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send, and since it was not their service, they flagged it.  (about: billing API, Ember team, marketing send)
- memory_id "1000811": On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Atlas team, image resizer, marketing send)
- memory_id "1000797" [decision]: As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by Cinder; ownership transferred from the Atlas team on that date.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000793" [constraint]: As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000775": The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.  (about: Atlas team)
- memory_id "1000772": As of 2025-09-30, the billing API depends on the feature flag service.  (about: billing API, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000767" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000743": The reporting service stopped using the ledger service because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000658" [decision]: Clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, decided at the Atlas standup on 2025-09-02.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000653" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-25, the ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000640" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000610": Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle as of 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman)
- memory_id "1000604": Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30, when on-call passed from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000554" [decision]: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000480": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the handover doc for the billing API for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000310" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000236": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000163" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14, partitioning work)
- memory_id "1000089": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
